title: Trump declares 'American space superiority for all eternity' in election night proclamation
caption:
A new presidential declaration outlines a vision for American leadership across the solar system. While it sets ambitious goals for lunar bases and Mars missions by 2028, the proclamation currently includes no new funding or policy changes.

Source: Space - Trump declares 'American space superiority for all eternity' in election night proclamation
